mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing isocarboxazid metabolism inhibition and serotonergic effects; combined monoamine oxidase inhibition and azole antifungal effects increase serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest fluconazole dose with careful monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, rigidity) and blood pressure elevation; consider alternative antifungal agent.
